ambiguities.issue: All five device subjects propose infrastructure:Artifact, which is present but has unresolved goal/intentionality comments. They are illustrative specialisations, possibly Tier-2 rather than common engineering Tier-1; do not promote the list wholesale. Broad current root parents allow candidate categorisation but do not settle a coherent engineering gateway. CorrosionDamage requires chemistry/material articulation; mechanical deformation/fracture need physics sources before expansion. Requirements and test records are outside physical domain articulation. AcceptanceTestEpisode means physical episode, never epistemic evidence validity.
ambiguities.decision: Keep blocked/provisional in research dossier, not executable src.

coverage.shortfalls: NASA process terminology is management-heavy. Physical manufacturing, fatigue, fracture and thermal engineering are insufficiently researched. Five narrow device examples do not demonstrate disciplinary coverage.
coverage.warning: Five recorded examples/category is not five semantically validated Tier-1 concepts. Blocked concepts do not satisfy acceptance coverage.
